Statement: At primary school I convinced my whole class that I was related to a famous footballer.
I won a free holiday to the Algarve as a prize in a supermarket competition when I was 21

I accidentally programmed a robot to do my homework for me and had to take it back to the lab
I named my first goldfish Gordon Ramsay because it kept spitting its food out.

I won a prize for the best homemade jam at a local school fair in my final year of secondary school

I won a prize for the longest fingernails at a local nail salon when I was 16
I was given a trophy for being the slowest 100m runner at a school sports day
I was given a parking ticket for a car I didn't own, and the owner just laughed and handed it back

I won a prize for the best 'Worst Dancer' at a local dance competition in my final year of secondary school

I accidentally filled up my dad's car with helium instead of petrol during the school holidays
I was stuck in a slow-moving bus queue for three hours during the M25 traffic jam last summer
I once ate cereal with orange juice instead of milk because we'd run out, and I actually liked it.
I once got stuck in a revolving door at the shopping centre and had to be cut out by the firefighters
I convinced my friends that I was a professional snail trainer and we competed in a snail racing tournament

I once accidentally dyed all my dad's white shirts pink by washing them with a red sock.

I accidentally went to school on a Saturday and didn't realise until I found the gates locked.
My family has a tradition of eating Christmas dinner in fancy dress, and last year I was a lobster.
On a school trip I got separated from the group in a museum and ended up in a staff meeting.

My grandad taught me to juggle with satsumas and I can still keep five in the air.

I once tried to make toast in the microwave and set off every smoke alarm in the house.
I've never seen a single Star Wars film all the way through, even though I own all of them.
I won a regional competition for building the tallest tower out of dry spaghetti and marshmallows.
I once got lost in a shop in Cardiff and had to be found by the store's security team

I sleepwalked into the garden once and woke up holding a watering can.
